review.note: Retracted in M21: the secret Anglo-Portuguese declaration of 14 October 1899 — Britain reaffirming its guarantee of the Portuguese colonies, Portugal closing Lourenço Marques to arms for the Transvaal — is genuinely significant. But only one consequence can be argued for it from this bibliography, Portugal’s belligerence of 1916, and a second edge would rest on the same argument. Worth reviving once the 1890 Ultimatum is in the atlas.
